mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that can potentiate oxacillin nephrotoxicity and impair renal clearance of oxacillin metabolites.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and urinalysis regularly; ensure adequate hydration; consider liposomal amphotericin B formulation to reduce nephrotoxicity; adjust oxacillin dosing based on creatinine clearance.
